definitions.explanation: The state of losing or being defeated in a competition, game, or contest.

examples.japanese: 3{連敗|れんぱい}で{負|ま}けが{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: Losses continue with three consecutive defeats.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{試合|しあい}は{負|ま}けだった。

notes:
{負|ま}け is the noun form of {負|ま}ける (to lose). It indicates defeat in competition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {負|ま}けが{込|こ}む (to be on a losing streak)
- {負|ま}けを{認|みと}める (to acknowledge defeat)
- {負|ま}け{知|し}らず (undefeated)

SPORTS/COMPETITION:
- {勝|か}ち{負|ま}け (winning and losing, victory and defeat)
- 3{勝|しょう}2{敗|はい} (3 wins, 2 losses)
- {負|ま}け{越|こ}し (more losses than wins)

IDIOMATIC:
- {負|ま}け{惜|お}しみ (sour grapes, being a sore loser)
- {負|ま}け{犬|いぬ} (underdog, loser)
